prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: hit while turning left. Injury: knee injury. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1085; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], regarding the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was lawfully proceeding through an intersection when your insured turned left across their path and struck the side of our client's vehicle. The police report and the physical damage to both vehicles support the conclusion that your insured failed to yield the right of way and bears full responsibility for this collision.

As a direct result of the impact, our client suffered a serious knee injury. Medical records document ligament damage, persistent swelling, and restricted mobility, and our client has required ongoing physical therapy. Our client has been unable to perform work duties and daily activities as before, and the recovery timeline remains uncertain.

Our client's damages include past and future medical expenses, lost income, diminished earning capacity, property damage, and the pain, suffering, and loss of enjoyment of life caused by this injury. Supporting documentation, including medical bills, wage records, and treatment notes, is enclosed.

To resolve this claim without litigation, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will proceed with filing a lawsuit to recover the full value of our client's losses.
